text:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident fired: INC12345 - api-gateway-apac error rate spike (5xx) > 3% over 5m. Auto-page to rotation 'oncall-sre'.

pagerduty: Incident assigned to dave_oncall (1/1) - acknowledge to stop escalation.

dave_oncall: Acked. Investigating. :mag:

alice_dev: I'm seeing 502/503s hitting /v1/generate on apac-edge, rate ~4.2%.

ben_ops: No deploys in the last hour. Looking at LB and upstream health.

carmen_sre: Canary upstream (auth-proxy-apac) shows a ton of 503s and k/v cache evictions.

dave_oncall: Routing change: shifting 40% traffic to eu to mitigate. Applying weights now.

incidentbot: Routing action recorded. Will escalate in 5m if incident remains UNRESOLVED.

ben_ops: KV proxy mem pressure high (eviction rate 30%). Pods restarting intermittently.

alice_dev: Logs from kv-proxy:
```
2026-03-15T03:12:11Z error failed to fetch key: KMS 500
2026-03-15T03:12:12Z warn cache miss spike
```

dave_oncall: Restarted kv-proxy pod kv-proxy-2 in apac canary. Crashlooped, logs show KMS 500s.

carmen_sre: Cross-checking KMS: saw a rotation job kicked in for apac at 03:11 UTC. Suspect correlation.

alice_dev: Rolling back KMS rotate flag for apac to be safe.

ben_ops: After rollback + kv-proxy restart, 5xx rate dropping to 0.9% over 2m. Monitoring.

dave_oncall: Keeping the route shift for now, monitoring 10m. If stable we'll remove shift gradually.

carmen_sre: Customer-impact update: ~18 customers in APAC experienced transient request failures (failures >1%) between 03:10-03:22 UTC. CS notified.

csbot: Notifications sent to customers: acme-corp (ticket INC-789 opened), buildly (alert acknowledged), dataworks (scheduled follow-up).

alice_dev: Opening PR to add safety check to KMS rotation (canary gating) and an alert for kv-proxy KMS error spikes.

dave_oncall: Will create postmortem stub and tag infra/runbook. Tagging @oncall-manager for follow-up.

ben_ops: Leaving a short-lived runbook note: if kv-proxy sees KMS 5xx, rollback rotate flag and restart kv-proxy.

carmen_sre: Thanks team. Marking incident as mitigated but keeping OPEN for postmortem. :thumbsup:
